queries.name: cf_aug_runtime_total
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(ISNULL(ventas_total,0)) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_runtime, SUM(ISNULL(tickets_total,0)) AS tickets_runtime, SUM(ISNULL(pax_total,0)) AS pax_runtime FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS' AND fecha_operacion >= '2026-08-01' AND fecha_operacion < '2026-09-01'

queries.name: cf_aug_detail_total_before
queries.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 THEN ISNULL(importe_neto,0) ELSE 0 END) AS decimal(18,2)) AS ventas_detalle, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 THEN id_transaccion END) AS tickets_detalle, SUM(CASE WHEN ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1 THEN ISNULL(pax,0) ELSE 0 END) AS pax_detalle FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto WHERE unidad_negocio_id='CIENFUEGOS' AND fecha_operacion >= '2026-08-01' AND fecha_operacion < '2026-09-01' AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1
